detail_of_failure: When an attachment is equipped, attachment circuit does not changeover.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • The swing LEFT PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 09001) • The swing RIGHT PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 09002) Reference information • When the ATT mode is selected: The service circuit changes to the double acting circuit. The safety valve is set to low pressure. • When the B mode is selected: The service circuit changes to the single acting circuit. The safety valve is set to high pressure. • The safety valve setting changes only for port B. The port A side stays at low pressure setting at all times.
